def shell_sort(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2

    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):

            j = i
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:

                j -= gap
            arr[j] = temp

    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2
